description: Day Use = timed passes booked by the day (not overnight sites): shuttles (Moraine Lake, Lake O'Hara), parking, ferries, guided events, fishing. Call with NO query (or just a place) to LIST the available Day Use products. Call with a product/place in `query` (e.g. 'Moraine Lake shuttle', 'parking') PLUS date(s) and party size to get the open time slots with spots remaining.
name: search_day_use
title: Search Day Use passes (shuttles, parking, guided events)
